name: Thompson Dallas
insider_take: This sleek downtown sanctuary puts you in the heart of Dallas' cultural renaissance, where cutting-edge design meets Texas hospitality.
whats_special: Thompson Dallas boasts the city's most Instagram-worthy rooftop pool with panoramic skyline views, while its ground-floor Catbird restaurant serves as a local hotspot. The hotel sits in the vibrant Deep Ellum district, known as Dallas' creative soul with street art murals covering nearly every building within a 3-block radius.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 15+ for unobstructed views of both downtown's glittering skyline and the historic Reunion Tower, especially stunning during the nightly LED light shows.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the Dallas Arts District means world-class museums like the Nasher Sculpture Center and Dallas Museum of Art are just a 10-minute walk away. After dark, explore Deep Ellum's legendary live music venues where blues and jazz legends once performed.
pros: Premium downtown location in Dallas Arts District
Sophisticated modern design and stylish accommodations
Rooftop pool and bar with city skyline views
Access to Hyatt Privé benefits and amenities
cons: Urban setting may have city noise
